notes.title: 5 Minutes Rage - Hatred Edition
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26670790/fc6cde413dd324478e22ed25227c9d75fdc4a54e.png[/img]

Are you ready for a lot of additional hate, fury and envy? 
Here we are to delight you with the brand new 5 Minutes Rage - Hatred Edition! The 2.5D multiplayer game, half party game, half shooter, where 2 teams of junkbots fight until death to score a goal in a blaze of laser gun, explosive bullets and projectiles, is back with a completely new look. The Hatred Edition will be available for free for all the current owners of 5 Minutes Rages, of course! Check out the hateful contents you are going to enjoy in this frantic Hatred Edition:

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26670790/588b1616684bfe847e2a660e43b3501d7260f661.png[/img] 2 incredible new maps to humiliate your enemies in
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26670790/588b1616684bfe847e2a660e43b3501d7260f661.png[/img] 10 new wonderful pieces to bring your junkbot customization to another level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26670790/588b1616684bfe847e2a660e43b3501d7260f661.png[/img] 2 additional backgrounds full of hate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26670790/588b1616684bfe847e2a660e43b3501d7260f661.png[/img] Achivements bug now fixed and general additional improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Disco-ball and other updates!
notes.notes:
Patch 975M release notes:
- Ball pulsates in time with the music, so that it is more visible
- Music in main menu
- New crosshair, more visible
- New ball physics (should be more reliable and never pass through walls)
- Character collision a bit higher to better fit head
- More responsive aim
- Number of votes shown in vote map menu
- Fixed barrier respawn effect
- New game icon, splash and loading screen
- Less obtrusive goal effects
- Sparkle particles now bounce on surfaces (how could we live without this?)
- Better camera positioning when entering a new map

notes.title: Fixed prerequisites installation
notes.notes:
Prerequisites installation was broken, which could lead to crash at startup.
The game now automatically installs engine prerequisites if they are not already installed, and does not show UAC prompt anymore at subsequent launches.

notes.title: The Day of Rage is set!
notes.notes:
Each thursday, starting next week (16th february), matchmaking will be open from 17 to 23 (UTC) to test yourself against hordes of enemies! (well, we hope so, spread the word anyway). We're sending keys so you can activate 5MR on steam, once activated you can start your training with local matches or with steam friends online, and be prepared when the Day of Rage comes. If you still haven't subscribed to the beta, what are you waiting for?

http://www.indomitusgames.com/5-minutes-rage
